faqs.question: How many people should I invite to a Halloween dinner party?
faqs.answer: Six to twelve is the workable range for one seated table. Eight is the easiest number to plan, because it splits into two conversation groups of four, which is about the upper size of a spontaneous conversation in Dunbar's 1995 study.

faqs.question: Which courses go on a Halloween dinner party menu?
faqs.answer: Three courses: a starter that waits at room temperature, a main that reheats, and a dessert that sets in the fridge. Keep each course to one dish plus one side, so nothing needs you at the stove while guests are seated.

faqs.question: How far ahead can I cook for a Halloween dinner party?
faqs.answer: Cook the main and dessert the day before. The UK Food Standards Agency says to fridge cooked food within one to two hours and eat leftovers within 48 hours, so anything earlier should be frozen in portions instead.

faqs.question: When should I send Halloween dinner party invitations?
faqs.answer: About three weeks out: Saturday 10 October for Saturday 31 October 2026, or Sunday 10 October for Sunday 31 October 2027. Ask for allergies and diets in the same message so you know before you shop.

faqs.question: How much does a Halloween dinner party cost per person?
faqs.answer: Our estimates for 8 guests, from typical US supermarket prices in October 2026, run from about $7–10 a head for a vegan curry menu to about $13–17 for a lamb tagine menu. Drinks, decorations and any hired chairs are extra.

faqs.question: How do I handle food allergies at a dinner party?
faqs.answer: Ask on the invitation, check each reply against the UK's 14 regulated allergens, and design the allergen out of the dish rather than cooking a separate version beside it. Serve sauces and toppings on the side so guests can opt out at the table.

faqs.question: Is vegan food safe for someone with a milk or egg allergy?
faqs.answer: Not automatically. The Food Standards Agency warns that food labelled vegan can still contain allergens through cross-contamination, so read the 'may contain' line on chocolate, stock cubes and anything else bought ready-made.

faqs.question: How do I make a Halloween dinner menu halal?
faqs.answer: Buy meat from a certified halal butcher and keep wine, beer and spirits out of anything cooked. Check desserts for gelatine, or serve a meat-free menu such as a vegetable curry, which suits halal, vegetarian and vegan guests at once.

faqs.question: How should I seat guests at a Halloween dinner party?
faqs.answer: Seat the table in groups of four, with one easy talker in each group, couples split across groups, and the host mid-table near the kitchen. Swap seats once before dessert so everyone meets a new group.

faqs.question: Can I use a SubhSandesh page to invite my dinner party guests?
faqs.answer: No. SubhSandesh's Halloween pages are one-person greeting pages, not invitations or RSVP trackers; use a group message for that. A page suits the one guest who can't come or a thank-you to your co-host afterwards.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Halloween Dinner Party Ideas: Menu, Timeline and Seating for 6–12

The Halloween dinner party ideas that hold up for 6 to 12 guests are structural: a three-course menu cooked the day before, a seating plan built in groups of four, and one short break between the main and dessert. Halloween falls on Saturday 31 October 2026 and Sunday 31 October 2027, so invite three weeks out and ask about allergies on the reply.

Do not leave the cooking for the day. Our nearest measured analogue for festival prep is Raksha Bandhan 2026, when 49.4% of SubhSandesh greeting pages were built on the festival day itself (n = 89, a small sample from a different festival). Plan for the opposite, and keep the invitation short: 48.3% of shared SubhSandesh pages are opened on a phone, so assume yours will be read on one small screen.

Below are three sample menus with estimated cost per head, a T-minus kitchen schedule, dietary planning and a seating plan.

## What is a Halloween dinner party?

A Halloween dinner party is a seated meal for a fixed number of guests, served in courses, with Halloween as the theme rather than the excuse for a crowd. Unlike a buffet party, the guest list is capped by your chairs and the evening runs on a timetable.

That cap is the point. Six to twelve people means one table, one conversation map and one shopping list you can actually cost, which is why the rest of this guide plans for eight and scales.

## The three-course Halloween dinner party menu: 3 sample menus

Every menu below follows the same rule: one starter that waits at room temperature, one main that reheats, one dessert that sets in the fridge. Nothing needs you at the stove while guests are seated.

Keep each course to one dish plus one side. A 2021 [meta-analysis of 30 studies on food variety](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC7948867) in the *American Journal of Clinical Nutrition* found that more variety at a meal reliably raises how much people eat (a small-to-medium effect, Hedges' g = 0.41). Five sides per course means more leftovers and more cooking, not happier guests.

### 1. Black Lantern menu (meat, halal-adaptable)

- **Courses:** smoky charred-aubergine dip with warm flatbread; lamb, apricot and date tagine with saffron couscous; cardamom rice pudding topped with pomegranate seeds.
- **Make ahead:** tagine and rice pudding on the day before; dip the morning of; the couscous is the only thing cooked on the night, in about 5 minutes.
- **Suits:** meat-eaters. It is halal when the lamb comes from a certified halal butcher and no wine goes into the pot. Contains gluten, milk and sesame (tahini in the dip).
- **Cost per head (EST):** about $13–17 for 8 guests, based on typical US supermarket prices in October 2026.

### 2. Harvest Moon menu (vegetarian)

- **Courses:** baked feta with olives and figs, toasted sourdough; mushroom and lentil bourguignon over buttery mash; blackberry fool in small glasses.
- **Make ahead:** bourguignon and the blackberry compote on the day before; whip the cream and fold the fool 2 hours out; mash 1 hour out, held in a low oven.
- **Suits:** vegetarians. Contains milk and gluten, and the stock may contain celery, one of the UK's 14 regulated allergens. Use alcohol-free stock instead of red wine for guests who avoid alcohol.
- **Cost per head (EST):** about $9–12 for 8 guests, October 2026.

### 3. Midnight Garden menu (vegan)

- **Courses:** carrot, ginger and coconut soup served in mugs; chickpea and spinach coconut curry over black rice; dark chocolate-dipped clementine segments.
- **Make ahead:** soup and curry on the day before; dip the clementines that morning; rice 40 minutes before guests sit.
- **Suits:** vegans, vegetarians and halal guests, and it avoids most of the 14 allergens if you check two labels: stock cubes for celery and chocolate for milk.
- **Cost per head (EST):** about $7–10 for 8 guests, October 2026.

## Halloween dinner party menus compared: cost per head and prep

The table compares the three menus on cost, time and who they serve. Costs are our estimates from typical US supermarket prices in October 2026, not quotes.

| Menu | Cost per head, 8 guests (EST) | Hands-on time on the night | Dietary fit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Black Lantern | $13–17 | about 25 minutes | Meat-eaters; halal with certified lamb and no wine |
| Harvest Moon | $9–12 | about 40 minutes | Vegetarian; contains milk and gluten |
| Midnight Garden | $7–10 | about 30 minutes | Vegan, vegetarian and halal; check celery and milk labels |

For a mixed table, the vegan menu is the cheapest way to serve everyone the same plate. Serving one menu to all guests also keeps the cross-contact risk lower than cooking two mains side by side.

## The make-ahead timeline: a T-minus schedule

The [Food Standards Agency's chilling guidance](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/how-to-chill-freeze-and-defrost-food-safely/how-to-chill-freeze-and-defrost-food-safely) (published December 2017) sets the limits: get cooked food into the fridge within one to two hours, and eat leftovers within 48 hours or freeze them. That makes the day before the right cooking day; two days out sits on the edge.

Dates are given for 2026 (Saturday) and 2027 (Sunday):

- **T-21 days (Sat 10 Oct 2026 / Sun 10 Oct 2027):** invitations out, with one line asking for allergies and diets.
- **T-7 days (Sat 24 Oct 2026 / Sun 24 Oct 2027):** final headcount, chairs and plates counted, menu chosen, shopping list written.
- **T-2 days (Thu 29 Oct 2026 / Fri 29 Oct 2027):** shop; chop onions and roots, store them chilled.
- **T-1 day (Fri 30 Oct 2026 / Sat 30 Oct 2027):** cook the main and dessert, cool them in shallow portions, fridge within two hours.
- **T-3 hours:** table laid, place cards out, drinks chilling.
- **T-1 hour:** main reheating gently, starter plated, rice or mash on.
- **T-0:** guests arrive; you should have nothing left to cook except a side.

If you want to cook a week ahead, freeze the main instead. The FSA also notes that a dish frozen after cooking can be reheated only once after that, so freeze it in portions and thaw only what you need.

## Dietary planning: allergens, vegetarian, vegan and halal

Ask on the invitation, not at the table. One reply line ("Any allergies, intolerances or foods you don't eat?") turns a surprise into a shopping decision three weeks early.

The [Food Standards Agency's allergy advice](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/food-allergy-and-intolerance-advice-for-consumers/food-allergy-and-intolerance-advice-for-consumers) (updated 7 August 2026) lists 14 regulated allergens: celery, cereals containing gluten, crustaceans, eggs, fish, lupin, milk, molluscs, mustard, peanuts, sesame, soybeans, sulphites and tree nuts. Check every reply against that list, then check your labels against the reply.

The same page warns that food labelled vegan can still carry allergens through cross-contamination. A vegan menu is not automatically safe for a milk or egg allergy, so read "may contain" lines on chocolate and stock.

Three working rules for a seated table:

- **Design the allergen out of the menu.** At a seated dinner everyone eats the same plate, so a main with no nuts at all beats a nut-free version cooked next to the nut version.
- **Finish plates at the table.** Pomegranate, sesame or cream spooned on by the guest lets them opt out without you cooking a second dish.
- **Halal starts at the butcher.** Certified halal meat, a stock with no wine in it and a gelatine check on dessert cover most of it.

## Seating plan and pacing: groups of four and one break

Plan the table in groups of four, because that is about how many people one conversation holds. [Dunbar, Duncan and Nettle's 1995 study of freely forming conversational groups](https://europepmc.org/article/MED/24202831) in *Human Nature* found an upper limit of about four people in spontaneous conversation, a limit the authors link to how speech is produced and heard (abstract read; full text paywalled).

So a table of eight runs as two conversations, and a table of twelve as three. Seat one easy talker in each group of four, split couples across groups, and sit yourself mid-table so you can reach both ends and the kitchen.

A run of show for a 7 pm start:

- **7:00 pm:** arrivals, one drink, starter on the table.
- **7:40 pm:** main course served plated from the kitchen.
- **8:40 pm:** 15-minute break and seat swap.
- **9:00 pm:** dessert, then tea or coffee.
- **10:30 pm:** the natural end for a Sunday in 2027; Saturday 2026 can run later.

The break is the one activity the night needs. Everyone in an odd-numbered chair moves two places to the left, and each person tells their new neighbour the best thing they heard in their old group. If you live on a trick-or-treat street, leave a bowl by the door so the bell does not interrupt the main.

## Where a SubhSandesh page fits, and where it doesn't

SubhSandesh's Halloween pages are one-person greeting pages with partner, bestie, family and kids modes. They are not a party invitation tool, a menu printer or an RSVP tracker; a group text or email does that job better for 12 people.

Where one helps is the guest who cannot come. The [interactive Halloween card](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) takes about 5 minutes: up to six photos, a letter, and a jack-o'-lantern they carve until your word glows. It suits a quick "we saved you a seat" for a friend abroad.

For a co-host who did the washing up, the [premium Halloween page](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) takes about 10 minutes and adds a voice note of up to 60 seconds, up to 12 photos and a reply box. Platform-wide, 90.9% of started pages are published and shared, so it is a short job to finish. For thank-you ideas beyond Halloween, [browse every SubhSandesh template](https://subhsandesh.in/templates).

A dinner party is the wrong choice when your table seats fewer than six or your guests mostly want to dance; a buffet or a house party suits both better. And a page never replaces the plate you set aside for someone who lives nearby.

## Sources

- Embling R. et al., "Effect of food variety on intake of a meal: a systematic review and meta-analysis", *American Journal of Clinical Nutrition*, 29 January 2021 (Europe PMC, full text read).
- Dunbar R. I. M., Duncan N. D. C., Nettle D., "Size and structure of freely forming conversational groups", *Human Nature*, March 1995 (Europe PMC abstract only).
- Food Standards Agency, "How to chill, freeze and defrost food safely", GOV.UK, published 18 December 2017.
- Food Standards Agency, "Food allergy and intolerance advice for consumers", GOV.UK, published 18 February 2020, updated 7 August 2026.
